Here, $x$ and $-3x$ are like terms, so we group them, and then we add or subtract the coefficients.

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{3}+x-2{x}^{2}-3x & = \\ {x}^{3}+x-3x-2{x}^{2} & = \\ {x}^{3}+(x-3x)-2{x}^{2} & = \\ {x}^{3}+(1-3)x-2{x}^{2} & = \\ {x}^{3}-2x-2{x}^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$
